To:Workshop Registrants
From:The Flour Bread

Subject:Baking Class

Dear Students,

We are looking forward to seeing you at our Celebration Cake 101 session on 11 October. This is a reminder that although we supply the mixers and the ovens, participants are responsible for their own ingredients. You will need to bring at least three kilograms of flour and 250 grams of coloring paste in order to finish the project. If you have none, do not worry! You can purchase everything you need from our shop on the day of the class.

Sincerely,

The Flour Bread

Class Review

Posted by: Anneke Visser

I was pleasantly surprised when I arrived at the cake class! The session was led by Mateo Herrera, a well-known pastry chef whose sugar sculptures are currently on show at the City Museum. It was an honour to meet such a renowned figure, though I have to admit that his explanations were rather confusing and hard to follow for a beginner like me. Even so, I managed to finish a large celebration cake as a present for my cousin. She has a strong preference for the color green, so I was glad they had that particular coloring paste in stock. I cannot wait to collect the finished cake next week!
